QQQ.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (unofficial provider client)

interpretation.text:
QQQ’s 252-observation DFA H is 0.4964 on 2026-11-10, near the ideal independent, finite-variance returns reference of 0.5. R²=0.9718 measures fit quality only over the 12 supplied scales spanning 8–63 observations. H rose 0.0057 over one observation and 0.0120 over five. It stands 1.04 standard deviations above its prior-only 30-estimate baseline. Overlapping windows mean this is not a significance test.

Hill alpha is 3.273, using 1,000 observations, k=100 and x_min=0.01996 absolute log-return units. Conditional on a suitable tail model, lower alpha suggests heavier fitted absolute-return tails; higher suggests thinner tails. Alternative 5%/15% cutoffs give 3.593/3.040, not a confidence interval.

From 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-10, H fell from 0.5201 to 0.4964 and alpha from 3.300 to 3.273. These are uncertain descriptive estimates, not a crash forecast.
